html:
The port of Athens, about 7 km from the city. Themistocles had it fortified from 493 BCE, seeing that Athens' future was at sea. The planner Hippodamus of Miletus later laid out its streets on a grid.

The Long Walls made Athens and Piraeus one fortress, fed by ships. That is why Athens could sit out Spartan invasions in the Peloponnesian War.
